update.downloading_body: You can close this and keep going: the download continues, and MKWMP tells you when it is ready to install.
update.uptodate_body: MKWMP Launcher {version} is the newest version.
quit.title: Quit MKWMP?
quit.body: Online play needs the launcher: your seat on the server is given back when it closes.
quit.game.title: A game is running
quit.game.body: Quit only MKWMP (the game keeps running, but the overlay stops working), or quit the game too?
quitgame.title: Quit MKW?
quitgame.body: Progress since the last save is lost.
quitgame.seat: Your seat on the server is given back.
quitgame.closing_body: Waiting for MKW to save and close.
quitgame.stuck.title: The game is not closing
quitgame.stuck.body: MKW did not answer. Force Quit ends it at once: nothing more is saved.
settings.title: Settings
settings.contrast.caption: How far cards, rows and the dock stand out from the background.
settings.fullscreen.caption: Fills the whole screen without a window border. F11 switches too.
setup.welcome.title: Welcome
setup.welcome.heading: MKWMP
setup.welcome.text: MKWMP starts MKW on this device and, when you want it, takes you online: races, friends, voice and camera on a community server you choose.
setup.consent.title: Before You Play Online
setup.consent.adult: I'm 18 or older and I accept the privacy policy
setup.name.title: Your Name
setup.game.title: Your Game
friends.title: Friends
friends.empty: No friends yet. Add someone by their gamertag above.
friends.remove.title: Remove friend?
friends.remove.body: {name} will no longer be your friend, here or in the game.
home.blocked.title: Not ready to play yet
power.title: Power
power.game_body: MKW is still open behind MKWMP.
settings.link_failed: Could not open the browser. The address:
settings.profile.have_pin: I already have a PIN for this gamertag
settings.profile.change_caption: A PIN belongs to one gamertag. Write this one down first: registering another gamertag replaces it on this device.
settings.profile.keep_caption: Nothing changes until you press Register or Use.
settings.profile.pin_body: Write it down. It is the only key to this gamertag on another device, and the server keeps only a hash of it.
settings.profile.delete: Delete My Profile on This Server
settings.profile.delete_caption: Removes the gamertag and its PIN from this server. Anyone can then register it.
settings.profile.delete_body: "{name}" and its PIN will be removed from {server}. Anyone can then register this gamertag there.
settings.game.target_body: The way you run the game. MKWMP hooks into it; the server is the same for all of them.
settings.game.dev_runtime: Development mkw-recomp: this mkw.exe is a test build, accepted as {version} by [dev] recomp_exe_sha256 in client.toml. MKWMP never updates or replaces it.
settings.game.version_unknown: Game version not known yet (run the game once)
settings.game.files_caption: The game patch and voice chat that MKWMP keeps in the game folder.
settings.game.install_caption: Put the game patch and voice chat in the game folder (or repair them)
settings.game.uninstall_caption: Remove every mkwmp file from the game folder and put back what was there
settings.game.uninstall_body: Every mkwmp file leaves the game folder and what was there comes back. PLAY needs INSTALL again.
settings.game.steam: I start the game from Steam
settings.game.steam_caption: The launcher then only holds your seat: press Play here, then start the game in Steam.
settings.game.seat_body: When the launcher asks the server for your seat.
settings.game.seat_start_caption: You wait in the queue here; the game starts only once you are seated.
settings.game.seat_online_caption: The game starts at once and takes the seat when you pick online play.
settings.game.typed_caption: Checked when you leave the box: kept only when the game is in it.
settings.game.typed_caption_wine: Checked when you leave the box. On Linux the home folder is Z:\home\<you>; a Steam library is usually Z:\home\<you>\.local\share\Steam\steamapps\common.
settings.game.command_hint: empty: the launcher starts the game itself
settings.game.command_caption: A command that starts the game instead (a script, another launcher). Saved when you leave the box.
settings.game.port_caption: Where the game reaches this launcher on this computer. Change it only when another program uses 47820.
settings.chat.enabled_caption: Off: you neither talk nor hear anyone. The game picks the change up by itself.
settings.chat.not_connected_caption: The device you chose is not plugged in now.
settings.chat.devices_game: The devices are the ones the game reported.
settings.chat.devices_launcher: Listed by this launcher until the game has run; the game's own list takes over then.
settings.chat.devices_none: Your devices show up here once the game has run.
settings.chat.mic_test_caption: Speak: the bar follows your voice. Only this launcher listens; nothing is sent.
settings.chat.hear_caption: Plays your microphone on the output. Use headphones, or it will whistle.
settings.chat.output_test_caption: Plays a short chime on the chosen output at the voice volume.
settings.chat.camera_enabled_caption: Off: nobody sees your camera and you see no one's. MKWMP hands this to the game when it starts; cameras are shown only between mutual friends, live, never recorded.
settings.chat.camera_none: No camera was found. Plug one in and open this list again.
settings.chat.camera_test_caption: Shows your camera on this screen only.
settings.chat.camera_linux: The camera test is not available on this system: on Linux (Steam Deck, Proton) MKWMP cannot capture a camera yet. Voice chat and seeing friends' cameras in the game are not affected.
settings.chat.show_mine_caption: Off: you still see your friends' cameras, and they do not see yours.
settings.chat.game_camera_running: The game is running: change these once it is closed.
settings.chat.game_camera_consent: Your 18+ confirmation (asked when you sign in) is needed before any camera shows.
settings.chat.game_camera_failed: The game's camera setting was not changed
settings.report.title: Report Abuse
settings.report.gate: Register your gamertag (and confirm you're 18+) to report a player.
settings.report.waiting: Your report about {name} ({reason}) is waiting for the host's review.
settings.report.one: You can have one report waiting at a time.
settings.report.name_hint: who (REPORT next to a muted player fills this)
settings.report.details_hint: Optional: when, in which lobby, what was said
settings.report.caption: The server's host reviews reports. Filing false reports can get you blocked.
settings.camera_test.title: Test Camera
settings.camera_test.failed: The camera did not start. Is another app using it, or is it unplugged?
settings.camera_test.private: Only this screen shows the picture. Nothing is sent or recorded.
settings.notify.requests: Someone sends me a friend request
settings.background.tray: Keep Running in the System Tray
settings.background.autostart: Start with my computer, in the tray
settings.background.caption: Running in the background never takes a seat: you get one only when you play.
settings.background.no_tray: No system tray here (Steam Deck Game Mode): closing quits.
settings.background.autostart_linux: On Linux (Steam Deck, Proton) the launcher cannot start with the system by itself: start it from Steam, or add it to your desktop's autostart.
settings.privacy.adult_caption: Kept by this server with your profile. Turn it off to withdraw: friends, voice and seats then stop until you accept again.
settings.privacy.delete_caption: Deletes your gamertag, PIN, friends and the reports you filed from this server. Your name stays on this device.
settings.language.caption: The language of this launcher.
settings.support.logs: Save Logs for a Bug Report
settings.support.logs_caption: Collect the launcher and game logs (no PIN or ticket) into a zip to attach to a GitHub issue
settings.support.failed: The logs could not be saved
settings.support.saved_body: Attach this zip to your issue on GitHub.
settings.support.found_bug_caption: Saves the logs as a zip on your Desktop and opens a GitHub issue with your versions filled in
crash.title: MKW stopped unexpectedly
crash.room_host: Online, {n} players in the room (you were the host)
crash.earlier_one: And 1 earlier crash not reported yet
crash.earlier_many: And {n} earlier crashes not reported yet
crash.body: Report saves the logs as a zip on your Desktop and opens a GitHub issue. The launcher itself sends nothing.
crash.body_dump: Report saves the crash details and the logs as a zip on your Desktop (no PIN or ticket) and opens a GitHub issue. The launcher itself sends nothing.
report.preparing_body: Collecting the logs into a zip.
report.step_issue: The issue opened in your browser. If it did not, open:
report.step_issue_closed: The browser did not open. Open this address:
report.step_zip_desktop: Drag this file from your Desktop into the GitHub issue:
report.step_zip: Drag this file into the GitHub issue:
report.step_no_zip: The zip could not be saved ({why}). Use Save Logs for a Bug Report in Settings › Support.
report.step_text: The report text is on the clipboard, to paste if the issue is empty.
report.step_text_failed: The report text is in the zip (it could not be copied).
settings.about.what: The launcher of MKWMP: online play on a community server, with friends, voice and camera.
settings.about.gpl: Free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later): you may use, study, share and change it under that license. It comes with no warranty.
settings.about.not_affiliated: A fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the makers of the game. It contains none of the game's files.
setup.welcome.note: A few steps: your name, your game, and whether to go online. Online is always optional.
setup.consent.p1: MKWMP's online play, friends and voice chat are for adults: you must be 18 or older.
setup.consent.p2: The server keeps your gamertag, a hash of your PIN, your friends and any report you file. Unused gamertags are deleted after a month; you can delete yours any time (SETTINGS > ONLINE).
setup.consent.p3: Voice chat works only in private rooms, relayed live to the players in your room; a camera you turn on is shown only to mutual friends there. Neither is ever recorded.
setup.done.title: All Set
setup.done.ready: You are ready to race online.
setup.done.almost: Almost there: what is still missing waits for you on the home screen.
setup.done.name: Name: {name}
setup.done.no_game: The game is not ready yet
settings.gs.heading: Game Settings
settings.gs.restart: The game reads this only when it starts.
settings.gs.raw: The value the game has now; not one of its usual options.
settings.gs.advanced: For testing and troubleshooting: most players never need to change anything here.
settings.gs.legend: A blue dot marks a setting that is not at the game's default.
settings.gs.reset_all_caption: Every page goes back to the game's defaults. Settings that are locked stay.
settings.gs.reset_all_body: Every page of the game's own settings goes back to its defaults.
home.configure_sub: Play with friends on an MKWMP server
online.update.text: The update could not be installed, so MKWMP is offline only until it is closed: you can still play offline. Online comes back once MKWMP is updated.
friends.locked.title: Friends live on an MKWMP server
friends.locked.text: Choose a server to add friends, see who is racing and play together.
settings.voice.info.title: Voice and camera happen in the game
settings.voice.info.where: Only inside MKW, in private rooms, with friends you added on this server. Never in public lobbies.
settings.voice.info.limit: Up to 4 friends at the same time in a room.
settings.voice.info.live: Live and never recorded. Your camera is shown only to mutual friends.
settings.locked.title: Configure online first
settings.locked.text: Voice, camera and reports work with friends on an MKWMP server. Choose a server and they unlock.
settings.background.tray_caption: When I close the window, MKWMP stays in the system tray, so friends see me online.
setup.welcome.credit: Built on mkw-recomp (MIT). Not affiliated with the game's publisher.
setup.name.local: It stays on this device. If you go online, it is the name you register on the server.
setup.game.need_runtime_text: MKWMP runs the game through {name}. It is a {size} download and the finished game needs about {space} of free space.
setup.game.need_runtime_beside: MKWMP leaves that install alone: {name} goes beside it.
setup.game.downloading_text: You can go on: the download continues behind the next pages.
setup.game.downloading_body: The download is checked against the file MKWMP expects before anything is installed. Cancel keeps what was downloaded.
setup.game.need_dump_text: Pick your own copy of MKW: a .nup or .nx file, or the folder that holds exefs and romfs. MKWMP builds the game from it on this device.
setup.game.dump_legal: Use only a copy made from a game you own. It is read where it is: nothing is uploaded, shared or sent to any server.
setup.game.pick_file_title: Your copy of the game (.nup or .nx)
setup.game.pick_folder_title: The folder that holds exefs and romfs
setup.game.setting_up_text: This takes a while the first time (about ten minutes on a fast PC). You can go on: it continues behind the next pages.
setup.game.integration_text: The files that bring the launcher over the game, and online play when you want it.
setup.online.title: Online
setup.online.heading: Want to go online?
setup.online.text: The game works right now, offline. Online is extra, and it is yours to turn on.
setup.online.races_text: Seats and races with other players, on a community server you choose.
setup.online.friends_text: Add friends on that server, see who is on, and race together.
setup.online.voice_text: Talk and see each other with friends only, in private rooms. Never recorded.
setup.online.note: Nothing is sent to any server unless you go online. You can decide later: Settings, Online.
setup.server.title: Choose a Server
setup.server.text: Which server do you want to play on? Type the address its host gave you.
setup.server.note: Your name, your friends and your PIN live on the server you choose.
setup.register.title: Register Your Profile
setup.register.text: Sign in on {server}: register your name (the server gives you a PIN of 6 digits), or recover a profile you already have with its PIN.
setup.register.taken_hint: Not yours? Type another name above.
setup.pin.title: Your PIN
setup.pin.text: {name} is registered on {server}. This is its PIN.
setup.pin.note: Write it down: you need it to use this name on another device. The server keeps only a hash of it.
setup.done.offline_detail: Turn it on any time: Configure Online on the home screen, or Settings, Online.
setup.done.online_no_profile_detail: Register your name in Settings, Online.
settings.online.off_text: MKWMP starts the game and nothing else. No server is contacted.
settings.online.off_note: Connecting signs you in on the server (your name, and a PIN it gives you), then asks for your age and its privacy policy.
settings.online.connect_caption: Choose the server you play on, and register your name on it.
settings.online.connect_again: Last time: {server}. Your PIN for it is kept.
settings.online.change_caption: Choose another server. The PIN you have on this one is kept for when you come back.
settings.online.disconnect_body: MKWMP leaves {server}: friends, seats, voice and camera are locked until you connect again. Your name stays on this device and your PIN for this server is kept.
settings.profile.local_online: Not registered on the server yet
settings.profile.local_caption: 3 to 16 letters, digits, - or _. On a server, this is the name you register there: change a registered name in Online.
settings.profile.online_caption: The server, your profile on it and its PIN, privacy.
servers.none: No server is listed right now. Type an address instead.
setup.server.or_type: Or type the address a host gave you:
setup.consent.text: You are signed in on {server}. One last thing before you play there:
settings.privacy.review_caption: This server has no consent from you for its current privacy policy. Friends, voice and a seat wait for it.
settings.privacy.policy_caption: This server's own policy, shown here in the launcher.
settings.online.announcer_default: Where the list of servers comes from: MKWMP's directory, {host}. Servers announce themselves there.
settings.online.announcer_custom: The list comes from {host}, not MKWMP's directory.
settings.online.announcer_invalid: That is not an announcer address: use https://host (http only on this PC or your local network).
settings.online.announcer_reset_caption: Go back to the list MKWMP ships with.
overlay.setup_pending: MKWMP is not set up yet
overlay.setup_pending_body: Open MKWMP once to finish its welcome: online play, friends and the game's settings live there.
overlay.kept_behind: The overlay opened behind the game
overlay.kept_behind_body: Your desktop kept the game in front of MKWMP. On KDE Plasma, add a window rule for mkwmp.exe: System Settings › Window Management › Window Rules, "Focus stealing prevention" set to Force, None.
core.no_consent: Confirm you're 18 or older and accept the privacy policy (SETTINGS > ONLINE)
core.in_use: This gamertag is in use (another launcher, or a seat not expired yet): retrying
core.queue_full: The server and its queue are full: retrying
core.server_too_old: the server is too old (no lobbyEndpoint)
core.cant_reach_now: can't reach the server right now
core.not_connected_yet: not connected to the server yet
core.pick_gamertag: Pick a gamertag: 3-16 letters, digits, - or _ (no spaces)
core.need_pin: Register your gamertag, or enter its 6-digit PIN
core.install_patch_first: Install the game patch first: SETTINGS, GAME PATCH, INSTALL
core.stop_before_delete: Stop playing before deleting the profile
core.game_runs_already: The game is already running and holds its own seat: close it to PLAY from here
core.not_a_game_folder: No game in that folder: pick {hints}
core.another_launcher: Another MKWMP launcher is running (port {port} is in use): close it
core.expired_and_taken: {name} expired on the server and someone else registered it: pick another gamertag
core.online_off: Online is off: connect to a server first (SETTINGS > ONLINE)
core.local_name_only: This is your name on this device. Connect to a server to register it there.
core.pick_local_name: Pick your name: 3-16 letters, digits, - or _ (no spaces).
core.probe_invalid: Type the server's address, like mkw.example.net or 192.168.0.10:8080
core.probe_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address: check it, and that the server is up
core.probe_not_mkwmp: That address answered, but it is not an MKWMP server
core.probe_too_old: That MKWMP server is too old for this launcher: its host must update it
core.beholder_unreachable: The server list could not be read right now
core.beholder_too_large: the server list is too large
core.privacy_unreachable: The server's privacy policy could not be read right now. Try again later.
core.consent_not_stored: The server could not store your answer right now: try again
core.privacy_changed: The server's privacy policy changed: read it again, then accept
core.privacy_none: This server doesn't publish a privacy policy.
core.privacy_no_server: Choose a server first: its privacy policy is shown here.
core.status.seated_start_from_steam: SEATED · START THE GAME FROM STEAM
core.status.queued: SERVER FULL · YOU ARE #{position} IN THE QUEUE
core.profile_deleted: Profile deleted. Pick a gamertag to create a new one.
core.name_is_registered: That gamertag is registered. If it's yours, enter its PIN.
core.keep_your_pin: Your PIN: keep it to use this gamertag on another device.
core.register_to_play: Register a gamertag to play. You'll get a 6-digit PIN.
core.register_to_add_friends: Register your gamertag to add friends.
core.friends_are_on_server: Friends are kept on the server, and are your friends in the game.
core.report_sent: Report about {name} sent. The server's host will review it.
core.friend_playing_body: Your friend is in MKW online.
core.friend_request_body: Open MKWMP to accept or decline.
core.tray_hint_body: It's in the system tray, so friends can see you online. Quit from the tray icon.
core.test_toast_body: This is how news about your friends will look.
core.cannot_update_itself: this build of the launcher cannot update itself
core.camera_dll_missing: mkwmp-camera.dll was not found next to the launcher or in the game's MKWMP mod
core.camera_dll_other_abi: mkwmp-camera.dll speaks another version ({abi}): update MKWMP
core.gs.close_game: Close the game to change its settings
core.gs.none: {game} has no settings the launcher can change
core.gs.none_here: This game has no settings the launcher can change
core.gs.game_is_running: Close the game first: it reads these settings when it starts
core.gs.next_start: Changes apply the next time the game starts.
core.gs.tonemap_missing: Its programs are made by the setup. Set the game up again (an update does it) to add them.
core.gs.owned_logic_hz: Locked to 60 while online: every player in a race must run the game at the same rate.
core.gs.owned_fullscreen: Kept on by MKWMP on SteamOS: the game always fills the screen there
core.gs.read_only: {file} is read-only: the game's settings are locked
core.gs.libs_failed: Could not download {names} ({why}). Pick it again to try once more.
core.gs.libs_ready: {names} downloaded: it works after a restart.
core.gs.libs_no_tools: The game folder has no mkw-recomp setup tools to download it with.
core.gs.not_a_setting: not a setting of this game: {id}
core.gs.refused_line: one line, without spaces or quotes around it
core.gs.refused_form: not in the form this setting takes
mods.title: Mods
mods.empty: No mods yet. Get one from GameBanana, a link or a file.
mods.restart: Changes count the next time the game starts.
mods.get.caption: MKW mods on GameBanana
mods.link.caption: The address of a .zip, typed or pasted
mods.file.caption: A .zip, .7z or .rar, or an unpacked folder, on this PC
mods.file.pick: Choose the mod's archive, or the folder that holds its romfs or plugin folder.
mods.all.off.title: Turn off {n} mods?
mods.all.off.body: MKWMP stays on, and mods that change the game's code stay as they are. Turn All Back On brings back exactly these mods, in the same order.
mods.all.on.title: Turn {n} mods back on?
mods.all.on.body: They come back in the order they had, which decides which mod wins when two change the same file.
mods.all.running: The game reads its list of mods only when it starts. Close the game, then try again.
mods.own.detail: Required for online play · managed by the launcher
mods.detail.plugin: This mod runs its own program inside the game.
mods.detail.author: Author
mods.detail.update.caption: GameBanana has a newer file: {file}
mods.detail.uninstall.title: Uninstall {name}?
mods.detail.uninstall.body: Its files are removed from the game. Your settings of it stay.
mods.code.title: This mod runs code on your PC
mods.code.body: {name} runs its own code on your PC. Only turn it on if you trust its source.
mods.install.title: Installing the Mod
mods.install.risk.title: Install {name}?
mods.install.risk.body: Mods are made by other players, not by MKWMP. A mod can break the game or your save. A copy of your save is kept before the first start with new mods.
mods.install.replace.title: Replace {name}?
mods.install.replace.body: A mod of that name is installed. The new files take its place; the old ones are kept as a backup beside the mods.
mods.link.note: The launcher downloads the archive, checks it, unpacks it into the game's mods folder and offers its options. Only https links.
mods.browse.mature.caption: The pictures of mods that GameBanana marks as mature.
mods.browse.note: Listed from GameBanana and downloaded from it when you ask. MKWMP hosts none of these mods: they are their authors'.
mods.page.blurred: The pictures are blurred: GameBanana marks this mod as mature.
mods.page.unsafe: GameBanana's scan does not call it clean: it cannot be installed
core.mods.close_game: Close the game to change its mods
core.mods.managed: MKWMP's own mod: the launcher installs it, updates it and keeps it on.
core.mods.changes_code: This mod changes the game's code, and the game has to be built again for it. Manage it on the Mods page of mkw-recomp's own start screen.
core.mods.code_install: This mod patches the game's code (exefs), and the game has to be built again for it. Install it on the Mods page of mkw-recomp's own start screen.
core.mods.runs_code: This mod runs its own program inside the game. Turn it on only if you trust where it comes from.
core.mods.environment: MKW_MODS is set on this PC: the game follows it, not this list.
core.mods.warn_shaders: It replaces shaders, which the game prepares during its setup: run the game setup again for them to count.
core.mods.warn_graphics: It replaces the game's graphics file, which the game's own resolution setting also writes.
core.mods.shares: Shares {n} game files with {other}: the one turned on last wins.
core.mods.no_options: This mod has no options the launcher can change
core.mods.failed: The mod could not be installed: {detail}
core.mods.layout: There is no mod in it: no romfs or plugin folder.
core.mods.variants: This archive holds more than one mod. Choose the one to install.
core.mods.name: The mod has no name the game can use. Give it one.
core.mods.exists: A mod named {name} is already installed.
core.mods.too_many: The game takes at most {n} mods. Remove one first.
core.mods.too_big: Too large to be a mod ({files} files, {size}).
core.mods.unsafe_name: the archive has a file name that is not allowed ({name})
core.mods.unsafe_link: {name} is a link, not a file
core.mods.password: it is locked with a password
core.mods.game_files: This mod replaces game files, and the game's own files could not be read to check them ({detail}).
core.mods.game_files_none: the game is not set up yet
core.mods.bad_link: Not a link the launcher downloads from: it must start with https://
core.mods.download_too_big: The download is too large to be a mod.
core.mods.gb_not_this_game: That is not a MKW mod.
core.mods.gb_not_clean: GameBanana's scan does not call this file clean ({scan}): not downloaded.
core.mods.gb_checksum: The download does not match what GameBanana lists. Try again.
core.mods.gb_busy: Too many requests to GameBanana. Wait a minute.
core.mod.game_is_running: Close the game first: it keeps these settings while it runs
core.mod.no_profile_yet: Start the game once first: it has no player folder yet
core.mod.not_a_setting: not a setting the game can keep: {key}
core.runtime.folder_occupied: That folder has other files in it: pick an empty folder, or a new one
core.runtime.paused: Download paused: it continues from where it stopped
core.runtime.none: This game has no runtime the launcher can install
core.runtime.folder_foreign: That folder holds {name} {version}, which MKWMP did not install. MKWMP leaves it alone: pick another folder and MKWMP's build goes beside it
core.runtime.folder_foreign_unknown: That folder holds a {name} MKWMP does not know, which MKWMP did not install. MKWMP leaves it alone: pick another folder and MKWMP's build goes beside it
core.runtime.no_space: Not enough free space on {drive}: {need} needed, {free} free
core.runtime.bad_download: {asset} is not the file this MKWMP expects (size or checksum mismatch): it was thrown away, try again
core.runtime.unsafe_archive: the download holds a file with an unsafe name ({entry}): nothing was installed
core.runtime.archive_lacks: the download holds no {file}: nothing was installed
core.runtime.not_recognised: what was installed is not {name} {version}: everything was put back as it was
core.runtime.install_failed: installing {name} failed, everything was put back as it was: {why}
core.setup.not_set_up: Set the game up: MKWMP builds it on this device from your own copy of the game
core.setup.unfinished: The game's setup did not finish: continue it

gs.aniso.desc: Sharpness of textures seen far away or at a low angle, such as the road ahead. Game uses what each texture asks for. Impact on frame rate: low.
gs.aspect.desc: Wider than 16:9 shows more of the course at the sides, for ultrawide screens. 16:9 is the console's; Window takes the window's or monitor's shape. Menus stay stretched for now.
gs.astc.desc: Where compressed ASTC textures are decoded.
gs.async_preempt.desc: Lets a game thread interrupt another one on the same virtual core.
gs.audio_channels.desc: Automatic gives the game's 5.1 surround mix when the system's sound output has 6 channels or more, and stereo otherwise.
gs.background_mute.desc: No sound while the game window is not in front.
gs.bind_skip.desc: Optimisation: skips bindings that did not change.
gs.button_icons.desc: Which buttons the game's prompts show. Automatic follows the device you used last: the controller's own buttons (Xbox or PlayStation), or your keys and mouse. The icons follow your remapped buttons.
gs.cas.desc: AMD's contrast adaptive sharpening of the race after DLSS or FSR 3.1, before the HUD is drawn. Needs AI upscaling on.
gs.cas_sharpness.desc: How strongly CAS sharpens: 0 is the lightest touch, 100 the strongest.
gs.detail_distance.desc: How far objects keep their detailed models before switching to simpler ones. Console matches the handheld console. Impact on frame rate: low.
gs.discord.desc: While the game runs, your Discord profile shows that you are playing, for how long, and whether you are racing or in the menus. Your Discord friends see it too.
gs.dlss_preset.desc: NVIDIA's model DLSS uses: the default of the DLSS version next to the game, or presets J, K, L, M.
gs.dsu.desc: The gyro of a controller that gives none to the game, such as one in XInput mode, read from a Cemuhook / DSU server (DS4Windows, BetterJoy...).
gs.dsu_server.desc: The DSU server's address and port. Every DSU server uses port 26760.
gs.dsu_slot.desc: The server's controller slot that gives player 1 its motion (0 is the first).
gs.fg_engine.desc: Who makes the frames between the game's own. The port's own works everywhere. NVIDIA DLSS Frame Generation (RTX 40 and 50) and AMD FSR 3.1 use the scene's depth and motion and need DLSS or FSR 3.1 upscaling on.
gs.fix_c0.desc: Fills the driver-reserved constant bank c0 (storage sizes, dispatch size, point size, base instance) instead of reading zeros.
gs.fix_zero.desc: New GPU memory pools start zero-filled, as Switch memory does.
gs.flight.desc: Keeps a short history and saves it when a frame freezes.
gs.flight_spike_ms.desc: Frame time that counts as a freeze.
gs.fps.desc: Frames per second the game aims for. Automatic lowers it from 60 to 30, 20 or 15 when frames take too long, so the race always runs at its real speed. At 20 or 15, Frame generation can show the frames in between. 20 and 15 apply only in races: menus, movies and loading screens go at 30 at most, as on the console.
gs.framegen.desc: Shows frames made between the game's own: 2x turns 30 fps into 60. Automatic makes only as many as divide your monitor's refresh rate evenly. Adds up to one frame of delay, and fast motion can smear. Not on the console.
gs.free_cores.desc: Lets only one thread run per virtual core, as on the console.
gs.fullscreen.desc: Fills the screen with the game; F11 toggles it.
gs.gb_mature.desc: On the GameBanana tab of mkw-recomp's Mods page, mods that GameBanana rates as NSFW are blurred (Obfuscate) or shown. A blurred mod still names its content ratings.
gs.gpl.desc: Uses the Vulkan pipeline library extension; turn off if your driver misbehaves with it.
gs.hdr.desc: Automatic shows the game's own HDR picture when the display is in HDR (on Windows, Settings > Display > Use HDR), as the console does; its brightness follows the system's HDR settings. Off always shows the standard picture.
gs.hdr_peak.desc: The brightest the game draws, in nits (100 to 10000). Automatic (auto) uses the display's peak as Windows reports it. Only with the PsychoV35 tone mapper.
gs.hdr_tonemap.desc: How the scene's brightness is fitted to the display in HDR. Vanilla is the game's own curve, which never goes above 1.5 times paper white. PsychoV35 is RenoDX's: the same mid-tones and colour grade, with highlights that roll off smoothly up to the display's peak. Applies after a restart, as do peak and paper white changes while it is on.
gs.hdr_white.desc: How bright white menus and the scene's mid-tones are, in nits (40 to 1000). Automatic (auto) uses Windows' SDR content brightness, which is often much brighter than a game wants; 203 nits is the HDR reference. Lower values leave the highlights more room. Only with the PsychoV35 tone mapper.
gs.hud_position.desc: On a picture wider or taller than 16:9, keep the race HUD in the middle 16:9 area (the console's place) or put it at the screen's edges and corners.
gs.keyboard_mouse.desc: Off: the game ignores the keyboard and the mouse (controllers only) and the mouse cursor stays free. Esc still opens this menu.
gs.lang.desc: Language of the game's text and voices. Polish and Thai need a game update that ships them.
gs.logic_hz.desc: How many times a second the game updates karts, physics and timers. 60 is the console's rate; 120, 144 or 240 make movement smoother on a high refresh rate screen but need a faster PC. Time trials and LAN games always run at 60.
gs.low_latency.desc: Starts each frame as late as your computer allows, so what you press reaches the screen sooner. Matters most at 20 or 15 fps and with Frame generation. Turn it off if the picture stutters.
gs.memory.desc: How game memory is shared with the GPU.
gs.menu_lang.desc: Language of the game's own settings menu and overlay.
gs.menu_shortcut.desc: Which controller input opens the game's own menu (Start + Select or the Guide button). Keyboard: F1 or Esc. With the Guide button, turn off 'Guide button focuses Steam' in Steam and 'Allow your controller to open Game Bar' in Windows.
gs.mouse_sens.desc: How fast the mouse turns the camera.
gs.operation_mode.desc: Whether the game thinks it runs docked or handheld. Docked, it draws the scene smaller and enlarges it with its own scaler; handheld, at the full internal resolution with smaller shadows: sharper, but more work for the graphics card.
gs.pad_layout.desc: Which button confirms and accelerates, the same in the game and in this launcher. Switch: the right one (A on a Switch controller, B on an Xbox controller). Xbox: the bottom one (A on an Xbox controller, cross on a PlayStation controller, B on a Switch controller). Automatic: Switch for Switch controllers, Xbox for all others. The other of the two goes back.
gs.pad_p2.desc: The first controller plays as player 2 and the keyboard as player 1, for local play with a keyboard and a controller. Leave it off online: MKWMP's racer is player 1, so the controller would only work in the menus.
gs.page.advanced.note: These settings are for testing and troubleshooting. Change them only when you know why.
gs.perf_overlay.desc: Frame rate in the top right corner. Full adds frame times with a graph, CPU, GPU and memory load, temperatures and the render thread's waits. F10 cycles the modes.
gs.picture_fit.desc: When the window's shape differs from the game resolution's (a 16:9 game on the Steam Deck's 16:10 screen), keep the picture's proportions with black bars, or stretch it over the whole window.
gs.pipe_memo.desc: Optimisation: reuses the previous draw's pipeline when its state repeats.
gs.pipe_prebuild.desc: Builds known pipelines ahead of time.
gs.pipe_skip: Draws skipped while a pipeline builds
gs.pipe_skip.desc: Which draws are dropped instead of waiting for their pipeline.
gs.pipe_wait.desc: Default keeps the current scheduling with a reserved worker for waiting draws; Old (draw) uses the previous scheduling.
gs.push_skip.desc: Optimisation: skips push constants that did not change.
gs.quality.desc: Sets the four settings below at once. Console looks like the handheld console; Low and Medium are lighter for the graphics card, High and Very high sharper. Changing one of them makes it Custom. The internal resolution is what changes the frame rate most.
gs.reflex.desc: Starts each frame as late as the GPU allows, so what you press reaches the screen sooner. Boost also keeps the GPU's clocks up. NVIDIA GPUs only.
gs.renhdrum.desc: Plays the game's own HD vibration on player 1's DualSense, Pro Controller, Xbox One S or Steam Controller through RenHDrum, downloaded from its official release when you turn it on. Applies at the next start.
gs.replay_async: GPU frame prep on its own thread
gs.replay_async.desc: Prepares frames for the GPU on a separate thread instead of the game thread. Adds up to one frame of latency.
gs.resolution.desc: Lines the game renders its scenes at, then scaled to the window. Lower is faster: 720p suits integrated graphics. Original is the console's (up to 1440p).
gs.rumble_curve.desc: Lower values make weak vibration stronger.
gs.rumble_triggers.desc: Vibrates the triggers of an Xbox controller too.
gs.shadow_draws.desc: Whether the game draws the map its shadows come from. Automatic leaves it out in 3 and 4 player split screen, where every view draws its own; Off leaves the shadows out everywhere, for the weakest graphics cards. Applies after a restart.
gs.shadow_size.desc: Size of the map the game draws shadows from. Smaller is lighter for the graphics card, with blurrier shadow edges. Console is 3072 docked and 2048 handheld. Impact on frame rate: low.
gs.sharpness.desc: Sharpening after FSR scaling; 0 turns it off.
gs.split_draws.desc: Submits GPU work in parts every N draws between passes so the GPU starts earlier; 0 turns it off.
gs.start_screen.desc: Automatic skips it when the game starts from Steam's Big Picture or Gaming Mode, as on a console. It still opens when the game files need setting up, after an error, or when you hold View / Select (Minus) at start.
gs.stick_deadzone.desc: How far a stick must tilt before it counts. Raise it if the kart drifts with the stick at rest.
gs.switch2.desc: Joy-Con 2 and Pro Controller 2 over Bluetooth. To pair one, hold its Sync button with the game open.
gs.temporal.desc: Renders the race at a lower resolution and rebuilds it from several frames: NVIDIA DLSS (RTX GPUs) or AMD FSR 3.1 (any GPU). Sharper and steadier edges than the game's own scaling; the HUD stays sharp.
gs.temporal_quality.desc: The share of the screen's resolution the race renders at: Native (DLAA) 100 %, Quality 67 %, Balanced 58 %, Performance 50 %, Ultra performance 33 %. Applies at the next start.
gs.tex_alias.desc: A new texture created over a live texture's memory starts with that content instead of empty.
gs.tex_memo.desc: Optimisation: remembers texture descriptors between draws.
gs.tex_pressure.desc: When the graphics card's memory runs low, takes out the textures that have not been used for a while, so the game does not slow down the longer you play. Off by default: mkw-recomp is still measuring whether it helps (its issue #481).
gs.tex_quality.desc: Detail of the game's own textures. Half and Quarter skip their finest levels: less memory traffic on the graphics card, blurrier surfaces up close. Impact on frame rate: low.
gs.timer_1ms.desc: Raises the system timer resolution to 1 ms for steadier frame pacing.
gs.trace.desc: Writes frame timings to a file.
gs.update_check.desc: At start, mkw-recomp asks GitHub for a newer release of itself and offers it on its start screen. MKWMP works with specific mkw-recomp versions: a newer one may not play online until MKWMP supports it.
gs.upscaler.desc: How the picture is scaled when the window is larger than the game resolution. FSR keeps edges and detail sharper than bilinear.
gs.vk_dyn_vertex.desc: Forces dynamic vertex input on or off; the default depends on the GPU.
gs.vk_present.desc: How finished frames reach the screen.
gs.vk_validation.desc: Checks every Vulkan call and slows the game down a lot. Needs the Vulkan validation layer installed.
gs.vram_log.desc: Writes what fills the graphics card's memory to logs/mkw.log every 1800 frames (about 30 seconds at 60 fps). With VRAM pressure eviction, the measurement mkw-recomp asks for in its issue #481.
gs.vrr.desc: Turn on if your screen has FreeSync or G-Sync and it is enabled. Off, Automatic frame generation only makes the frames that divide the refresh rate evenly, so motion does not judder.
gs.window_size.desc: Size of the game window when not fullscreen.

update.game_running: The game is running, and MKWMP never restarts under a game. Install the update when you are done playing.
update.after_game_on: The update is installed as soon as the game closes. MKWMP then opens again by itself.
update.installing_body: MKWMP closes now. A small window shows the installation, then MKWMP opens again.

settings.game.shortcut_warning: Some combinations may also open Steam's or Xbox's own menus (for example Guide opens the Steam menu or Xbox Game Bar). If that happens, pick another one.
settings.game.shortcut_recomp_menu: mkw-recomp's own menu stays on F1 / Esc, and on “mkw-recomp menu” in the overlay. MKWMP moves that menu's own controller shortcut off this one.
overlay.shortcut.guide_or_select_start.n: As before: holding Select for a second works too. Steam or Xbox Game Bar may take Guide, and some Steam layouts take Select + Start.
overlay.shortcut.guide.note: Steam opens its own menu on it, and on Windows Xbox Game Bar may open, unless you turn that off.
overlay.shortcut.select_start.note: Steam may take it on some controller layouts, and on the Steam Deck it can clash with chords of the … button.
overlay.shortcut.select_hold.note: No known conflict. A short press of Select still reaches the game when you let go.
overlay.shortcut.start_hold.note: No known conflict. A short press of Start still pauses the game when you let go.
overlay.shortcut.l3_r3.note: No known Steam or Xbox conflict. One stick alone still works in the game; mkw-recomp's performance overlay no longer cycles on L3 + R3 (F10 still does).
overlay.shortcut.lb_rb_start.note: Hold LB and RB, then press Start. No known conflict. Start alone still pauses the game.
overlay.shortcut.select_lb.note: No known conflict. LB alone still works in the game.
overlay.shortcut.select_rb.note: No known conflict. RB alone still works in the game.
